units.text: If you received an other than honorable, bad conduct, or dishonorable discharge, you may not be eligible for VA benefits.
supporting_chunk_ids: Eligibility Requirements For VA Home Loan Programs | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states that with these discharge statuses, you may not be eligible for VA benefits.

units.text: However, there are two ways you can try to qualify: apply for a discharge upgrade, or go through the VA Character of Discharge review process.
supporting_chunk_ids: Eligibility Requirements For VA Home Loan Programs | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context lists these two ways to try to qualify.

units.text: For VA home loan eligibility specifically, you generally need a discharge that is not dishonorable and meet minimum service requirements
supporting_chunk_ids: Eligibility Requirements For VA Home Loan Programs | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context says you may get a COE if you didn't receive a dishonorable discharge and meet minimum active-duty service requirements.

units.text: but certain discharges for hardship, government convenience, reduction in force, medical conditions, or service-connected disability may still allow a Certificate of Eligibility.

units.text: If your discharge was dishonorable or bad conduct, you should pursue one of the two review options to potentially restore eligibility.
